arguments.value: ArTara and the University of Iowa entered into an agreement for ArTara to use the University’s OK-432 clinical data and related records to support development and regulatory approval of ArTara’s TARA-002 product for lymphangioma. The University gives ArTara an exclusive license to use the program data for this project and for regulatory filings worldwide, and an exclusive right of reference to the University’s regulatory filings; the University may assign the IND to ArTara if requested. ArTara funds the project at $30,000 per year, may owe an approval milestone payment if TARA-002 is approved, and must pay tiered royalties on net sales plus additional sales-based milestone payments. The University keeps ownership of the original program data and medical records, while ArTara owns the project documentation it creates and any inventions solely made by ArTara; jointly developed inventions are jointly owned. The agreement also sets confidentiality, publication review, insurance, indemnification, termination, and other standard contract terms, and allows either party to end the project with notice.
